notes.title: Plaything 1.1 is coming!
notes.content:
We've been hard at work the last few weeks! Due to popular demand we added a few things like Localization for German and French - including full voice! Thanks to each of you for helping us improve the game :)

[h2]Fixes & Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug not showing the loaded options,
[*] Fixed an issue with the back button on escape,
[*] Fixed Achievement "Vented",
[*] Fixed Achievement "Battered" and related hint,
[*] Fixed a bug with Volume Sliders
[*] Fixed a bug with Steam Overlay Pause
[*] Fixed a bug not showing the packaging animation after 4 Minigames beaten,
[*] Improved some colliders for performance,
[/list]

[h2]New:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added [b]new Minigame[/b]: Samuel Says, unlocked at Victim 25,
[*] Added [b]Localization [/b]for German(DE) and French(FR), Voice+Text,
[*] Added [b]Progression [/b]System! (This resets all players to Victim 1),
[*] Added [b]Steam Leaderboard[/b] for escapes,
[/list]

[h1]Samuel Says[/h1]
In the new progression system you will be able to unlock rooms as you keep trying to escape. While some of the previous rooms are gradually unlocked again, there is also a new room and minigame further down the line: Samuel Says. You get a sequence of colors and tunes to match - take too long or press the wrong button, and you'll end up a smear on the ground!

[h1]Details about the Progression System[/h1]
Since we introduce the new Progression System, all Victims will be reset to 1 in this patch. From then on, you can see at what point you get some goodies to give you extra chances if you die. You get some unlocks by default, while picking one of the others. The picked bonus will only last for this run though! Unlocked rooms go into a pool of all unlocked rooms from then on, if you don't get the new one right away don't fret.

In case you manage to escape, you get a large selection of boni for your next run, so you can try to find other means of escape, regardless of your current attempts. We also are adding a Steam Leaderboard that will keep track of your best escape time!

notes.title: Plaything Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Time for a second round of bugfixes and improvements :)

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed a graphical issue with vent covers
- Fixed the case of dissappearing skirting
- Fixed a scaling issue with Inventory (Pause)
- Fixed a bug where staying in LeapFrog during Cleanup wasn't fatal

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
- Increased Duration of Shutdown to 3 minutes, Siren to 30s
- Improved Sensitivity Slider values, might need new adjustment on existing installs
- Added FOV Slider to options, default starting value is old FOV
- Removed weights physics interfering with each other for easier use

If you reported an issue that is not on the list, we are still working on it, don't fret! Thanks again and good luck escaping,
[i]Bandaloop Games Team[/i]

notes.title: Plaything Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Thank you all for playing our game and giving valuable feedback! We've tried to get to everything :)

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed an issue with Depth Of Field sometimes remaining after dropping an inspected item; There's still an occasional bug we're looking at!
- Fixed an issue with some transform parenting

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
- Hopscotch To Hell: Increased space to walk in safely
- Scales: Removed hidden mechanic that kills you on using too many weights per scale, leading to confusion
- Dollhouse: Added a fixed note by a previous victim to indicate leaving the space is possible
- Dollhouse: Added a cloth to cover the door

If you reported an issue that is not on the list, we are still working on it, don't fret! Thanks again and good luck escaping,
[i]Bandaloop Games Team[/i]

notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
It's time to escape...

[h1]Plaything now availabe![/h1]
We're excited to release 1.0.0 of PLAYTHING today! Master the games, survive the traps and escape your captor! But try not to become part of his collection...

[h2]Patch Notes 1.0.0[/h2]
- Fixed an issue with resetting the randomized games
- Fixed a bug that caused a sound issue
- Added Join Discord Button
- Added Welcome Message
- Fixed an issue with some paintings
- Minor Polish issues, optimization

If you encounter issues, please do report them to us, and we'll get to it as soon as possible - either on Discord or by Mail (support@bandaloop.at). We can't wait to see you play!
[i]Bandaloop Games Team[/i]
